scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3001/api/health -t 30000 && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build:prod: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push --prefix backend && npm run db:backfill --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
